instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Decide whether a person should get a nudge now, honouring their opt-out and a rate limit", and give it context; risk_threshold.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:decide-a-nudge and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes a person's context (a risk number, whether the rate limit still allows a nudge, whether they opted out) and the person's threshold, tone and framing.
